reason: The first Stage-2 capture was cancelled during ORION startup after an architectural audit found that the task adapter received 256-D scene-query memory but not ORION's 89-D command, ego-state, and temporal ego-pose context. Continuing would have produced artifacts incapable of learning on-path versus off-path relevance.
result_policy: The partial directory is retained only as an auditable runtime record. It must not be used for training, evaluation, or safety claims.
replacement_change: Capture and fuse the same-frame 89-D ORION task context together with frozen Stage-1 spatial uncertainty and pre-LLM planning memory.
